localChanges.summary: Full English SKILL.md aligned with upstream v3.0.0 while adding handoff.md as the fourth planning file. Ports the upstream inject-plan / gate-stop / attest-plan / ledger / phase-status / resolve-plan-dir / set-active-plan / init-session scripts (renamed planning-with-files → planning-context, PWF_ → PCX_, pwf-sha → pcx-sha) and patches them for the 4-file structure. Adds commands/ (plan-goal, plan-loop, plan-attest). Keeps autonomous / gated modes, nonce delimiters, hash attestation, PreCompact reminder, and Windows PowerShell fallback. v1.1.0: relocates all planning files from project root to .context/ directory to isolate from co-installed planning-with-files (hooks now only fire when .context/ exists). v1.2.0: formalises main-line vs side-task model — main-line always at .context/ root, side-tasks flat at .context/<slug>/, nested side-tasks forbidden. resolve-plan-dir drops the newest-mtime fallback so unresolved always returns to main-line. inject-plan auto-injects main-line handoff head when a side-task is active, giving side-tasks read-only memory of main-line without ballooning turn-start context. Adds close-plan.sh with agent-draft/user-confirm contract, /plan-side and /plan-close commands, Active Side-Tasks table in the main-line handoff template, and Rule 8 rewritten to require ask-before-branch (never auto-decide phase vs new side-task).
